name: Permit type
description: The kind of permission a government grants. Kept broad and based on the mechanism, not the local name - the same permission is a building permit in one country and a Baugenehmigung in another. A list of national names wouldn't travel.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Building
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to build or change a structure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Demolition
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to tear a structure down.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Planning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to change land use or start a development, separate from permission to build.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Occupancy
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to occupy or use a finished structure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Trade or professional licence
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission for a person to work in a regulated trade.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Event
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to hold a public event or gathering.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Signage
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to put up signage or advertising.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Alcohol
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to sell or serve alcohol.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Environmental
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission for a regulated environmental activity, like discharge, extraction, or tree removal.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Excavation or right of way
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to dig up or occupy public land.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Transport
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission related to vehicles, hauling, or running public transport.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Other
hasDefinedTerm.description: Anything that doesn't fit the other types.
